display.purpose: The one headline on the envelope sheet.

headline.purpose: Section headings sitting on a 2px ink rule.

title.purpose: Sub-headings within one side of the envelope.

lead.purpose: Single lead line under the display, max 34em.

label.purpose: Field labels, nav, legend, table heads.

hand.purpose: Values written into fields, doses, log results, step blanks.

shadows.name: app-panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Operate-layer panels (.panel, 14px radius). Not used on the envelope.

shadows.name: stamp-hover-in-motion
shadows.purpose: Only at the start of the stamp-press keyframe while the stamp hovers above the paper; removed by 55%. No resting shadows exist on the envelope.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: Stamp lifts at -6deg/1.1x, presses to 0.97 with a darker ink wash, settles at -3deg. Runs once after the ticks finish.

motion.name: tick-draw
motion.purpose: Stroke-dashoffset draw of hand marks in the dosage table.

motion.name: stamp-hover
motion.purpose: Stamp straightens and sinks on hover/press.

motion.name: fill-swap
motion.purpose: Outline buttons fill on hover; nav underline fades in.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables stamp-press, tick-draw and all hover transitions on the envelope.

theme.behaviour: Follows prefers-color-scheme until toggled; choice persisted in localStorage and synced across tabs; set before first paint by an inline script in index.html.

texture.name: paper-fibre
texture.value: SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise, baseFrequency .85, 2 octaves, 180px tile; alpha .025 light / .05 dark
texture.purpose: Layered under the paper colour on the envelope ground.

components.name: Rubber Stamp (primary)
components.description: The one primary action per envelope screen: a red double-bordered stamp set at -3deg.
components.html: เข้าสู่ระบบ
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 5px; border: 3px solid #c62b28; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #c62b28 5%, transparent); color: #c62b28; text-decoration: none; transform: rotate(-3deg); transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-stamp-face { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 26px 14px; border: 1.5px solid #c62b28; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 28px/1.2 'Anuphan', 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-stamp-face svg { margin-top: 4px; transition: transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-stamp:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #c62b28 11%, transparent); transform: rotate(-1.5deg) translateY(1px); } .ds-stamp:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-stamp:active { transform: rotate(-1.5deg) translateY(2px) scale(0.98); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3fbf; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Square ink-outlined action that fills solid ink on hover.
components.html: ตั้งค่ากล้อง

components.name: Header Band
components.description: Full-width solid-ink envelope flap with shop name, text links, theme toggle and an outlined login.
components.html:
CAMWELL ฉลากดูแลสุขภาพในที่ทำงาน

components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 76px; padding: 0 32px; background: #0b6b47; color: #f8faf7; } .ds-band-shop { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font: 700 30px/1 'Anuphan', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-band-shop span { font: 600 15px/1.2 'Anuphan', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-band-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; } .ds-band-link { padding: 14px 0; color: inherit; font: 600 16px/1 'Anuphan', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 6px; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-band-link:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-band-login { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 2px solid #f8faf7; color: inherit; font: 700 16px/1 'Anuphan', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-band-login:hover { background: #f8faf7; color: #0b6b47; } .ds-band a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f8faf7; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tick Box (four states)
components.description: Printed 26px square with a stroke-drawn hand mark: empty, tick (blue), ring (red), strike (blue).
components.css: .ds-tick { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 26px; height: 26px; margin: 0 14px; border: 2px solid #0b6b47; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-tick svg { position: absolute; overflow: visible; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-tick.is-tick svg { top: -11px; left: -1px; width: 32px; height: 32px; stroke: #1f3fbf; stroke-width: 3.2; } .ds-tick.is-ring svg { top: -13px; left: -13px; width: 48px; height: 48px; stroke: #c62b28; stroke-width: 2.6; } .ds-tick.is-strike svg { top: 0; left: -8px; width: 38px; height: 22px; stroke: #1f3fbf; stroke-width: 3; }

narrative.northStar: The Office Medicine Envelope (ซองยาประจำออฟฟิศ)
narrative.overview:
Camwell's brand surface is one printed pharmacy envelope: a single sheet of paper, printed in one pharmacy-green ink, with a handful of marks someone made on it by hand. Every rule, box, band and letter is the same ink. The only other colours on the sheet are a ballpoint-blue pen (handwriting, tick strokes) and a red rubber stamp (the primary action, alerts that lasted). The envelope reads as care you take every day, not surveillance; information is laid out as instructions, a dosage table and a log, never as feature cards.

The system has two layers today, and they are not unified in code. The Persuade layer is the envelope world, shipped on the landing page (`/`) only; its tokens are the `--rx-*` custom properties scoped to `.rx`. The Operate layer is the incumbent app system in `frontend/src/index.css` (dashboard, camera, people, alerts, reports, gait, Dev Console, YOLO Console): a calm blue-accent panel UI on IBM Plex Sans Thai, with its own light and dark tokens on `:root`. New Persuade/brand surfaces take the envelope; new app screens keep the Operate tokens until a deliberate migration says otherwise.

Both layers share one theme mechanism: `<html data-theme="light|dark">`, set before first paint by an inline script in `index.html`, following the OS until the user toggles, then persisted in `localStorage` under `camwell:theme` (`useTheme.ts`). In the envelope, dark is a reverse print: the green ink becomes the ground and paper colour becomes the type.
keyCharacteristics: One ink, one sheet: pharmacy green on near-white paper, with a faint paper-fibre noise texture.
Hand marks in ballpoint blue: Sriracha handwriting and stroke-drawn SVG ticks, never icon-font glyphs.
One red rubber stamp per screen as the primary action; red also marks alerts that lasted. Red never carries good news.
Square printed rules and boxes; the stamp is the only rounded, rotated object.
Thai-first typesetting: phrase-level non-breaking spans so Thai phrases never split mid-word.
Dark theme is reverse print, not a dimmed palette.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Everything printed on the envelope is the single ink token. A second printed colour, a tint ramp of the green, or a grey text tone breaks the envelope.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Blue is what a person wrote; red is what was stamped or must be heeded. Neither appears as decoration, and neither is used for printed structure.

rules.name: The Reverse Print Rule
rules.body: Dark theme swaps paper and ink (band becomes paper, its type becomes ground) and lifts the pen and stamp to their light reverse values. It never introduces new hues.

rules.name: The Phrase Break Rule
rules.body: Thai copy breaks only between phrases: each space-separated phrase is wrapped as a non-breaking span, and headings use `text-wrap: balance`, paragraphs `pretty`.

rules.name: The Written-In Rule
rules.body: Sriracha is reserved for values a person would fill in on the label. Printed labels, headings and instructions never use it.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by rule weight and ink fill, not elevation. No surface on the sheet carries a box-shadow at rest.

dos: **Do** print every rule, box and letter of an envelope surface in the single ink token, and switch it through the reverse-print dark tokens rather than per-component overrides.
**Do** keep blue for hand marks and focus, and red for the stamp and alerts that lasted. Never use red or a warning label for good news such as the privacy promise.
**Do** use the four-state tick grammar (empty / tick / ring / strike) with the same meanings wherever status is shown.
**Do** wrap Thai phrases in non-breaking spans so lines break between phrases.
**Do** show real default thresholds from code on the label, and say they are defaults.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: the stamp press and tick drawing are disabled, and hover transitions are removed.
donts: **Don't** add a second printed colour, green tints, or grey text to the envelope.
**Don't** put a resting box-shadow on anything on the sheet; only the stamp's entrance shadow exists, and only in motion.
**Don't** round or rotate anything on the envelope except the stamp.
**Don't** use more than one stamp per screen.
**Don't** use icon-font or emoji glyphs for status; marks are drawn SVG strokes.
**Don't** apply the envelope tokens to app (Operate) screens, or the app's blue accent to envelope screens, until a migration decides it.
